items.question: Which mantras govern the placement of the flower after life-force installation?
premises: The practitioner has completed the installation of life-force at the end of worship.
The root mantra is specified as the means for the ritual action.
The arrow-mantra accompanies the placement of the flower.
items.inference: After installing life-force, the practitioner places the flower using the root mantra together with the arrow-mantra.
uncertainties: The precise identity of the mantra designated as śara+aṇu depends on the specific Śrīvidyā tradition.
items.plain_english: With the root mantra, the practitioner places the flower while using the arrow-mantra.
